title: The Sin Offering

questions.question: What type of sin was the sin offering for?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 4:2 (ESV): "If anyone sins unintentionally in any of the Lord's commandments."

questions.question: What did the anointed priest bring for his sin offering?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 4:3 (ESV): "If it is the anointed priest who sins... he shall offer for the sin... a bull from the herd without blemish."

questions.question: Where was the blood of the priest's sin offering sprinkled?
options: Seven times before the Lord in front of the veil
questions.correctAnswer: Seven times before the Lord in front of the veil
questions.explanation: Leviticus 4:6 (ESV): "The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle part of the blood seven times before the Lord in front of the veil."

questions.question: What animal did a common person bring for a sin offering?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 4:28 (ESV): "He shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without blemish."

questions.question: Where was the body of the bull burned when the priest sinned?
options: Outside the camp in a clean place
questions.correctAnswer: Outside the camp in a clean place
questions.explanation: Leviticus 4:12 (ESV): "All the rest of the bull... he shall carry outside the camp to a clean place."

questions.question: What did the whole congregation bring if they sinned unintentionally?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 4:14 (ESV): "The assembly shall offer a bull from the herd for a sin offering."

questions.question: What did a leader (ruler) bring for his sin offering?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 4:23 (ESV): "He shall bring as his offering a goat, a male without blemish."

questions.question: Where was the blood of the leader's sin offering put?
options: On the horns of the altar of burnt offering
questions.correctAnswer: On the horns of the altar of burnt offering
questions.explanation: Leviticus 4:25 (ESV): "The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering."

questions.question: What alternative could a common person bring instead of a goat?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 4:32 (ESV): "If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without blemish."

questions.question: What was done with the rest of the blood after applying it to the horns?
options: Poured out at the base of the altar of burnt offering
questions.correctAnswer: Poured out at the base of the altar of burnt offering
questions.explanation: Leviticus 4:7 (ESV): "The rest of the blood of the bull he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering."

questions.question: Who laid hands on the bull when the whole congregation sinned?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 4:15 (ESV): "The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull."

questions.question: Where was the blood put for the priest's and congregation's sin offerings (in addition to sprinkling)?
options: On the horns of the altar of fragrant incense
questions.correctAnswer: On the horns of the altar of fragrant incense
questions.explanation: Leviticus 4:7 (ESV): "The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense."

questions.question: How was the sin offering fat treated compared to a peace offering?
options: The same—all fat was removed and burned as in the peace offering
questions.correctAnswer: The same—all fat was removed and burned as in the peace offering
questions.explanation: Leviticus 4:26 (ESV): "All its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings."

questions.question: What was the result of the sin offering for the person who offered it?
options: The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be forgiven
questions.correctAnswer: The priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be forgiven
questions.explanation: Leviticus 4:26 (ESV): "The priest shall make atonement for him... and he shall be forgiven."

questions.question: How did the sin offering for the priest differ from a common person's offering?
options: The priest's required blood sprinkled before the veil; the commoner's only on the altar horns
questions.correctAnswer: The priest's required blood sprinkled before the veil; the commoner's only on the altar horns
questions.explanation: Leviticus 4:6-7 vs 4:30 — the priest's offering involved sprinkling before the veil and the incense altar, while the commoner's blood went only on the burnt offering altar.

key_verse_text: And the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin, and he shall be forgiven.
